sentences.text:
The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the respondent has filed a complaint case before the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Guwahati, which was registered as CR C Case No. 665/2023, wherein it was alleged that the respondent decided to purchase dumplings making machines from the petitioner's company and also paid an advance amount of Rs. 50,000/-
towards the said purchase.
4. However, in spite of the receipt of the advance amount, the same has not yet been delivered.
The complainant-respondent has alleged that the petitioner is engaged in deceptive practices and has cheated the present petitioner.

5. On filing of the complaint, the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1 st Class Kamrup (M) has took cognizance of offence under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code against the present petitioner issued processes to the petitioner.

6. The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the dumplings machine, which the respondent intended to purchase cost about of Rs. 1,90,000/- and as per the terms and conditions of the company, it is required that the 75% of the value of the machine has to be paid in advance at the time of placing the order.

7. However, in the instant case, the respondent has not paid the 75% of the value of the matching,
which he had ordered and therefore, the matching was not dispatched to him as per the terms and conditions of the agreement.
8. The learned counsel for the petitioner has also submitted that no cause Page No.# 3/3 of action arose at Guwahati.

9. The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the dispute, if any between the parties are purely civil in nature and this case has been filed with an intention to pressurize the present petitioner.

10. He submits that no ingredients of Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code in the averments made in the complaint by the respondent before the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class Kamrup (M).
11. Issue notice to the respondent.
12.

The petitioner shall take steps for service of notice to the respondent by registered post with A/D as well as by usual mode within seven days from the date of receipt of this order, returnable on 24.04.2025.

13. Let this case be listed on 24.04.2025.
